introduction: ERC-2612 extends ERC-20 with a permit function that allows token approvals via off-chain signatures instead of on-chain transactions. Users sign an EIP-712 typed data message authorizing a spender, and anyone (a relayer or the spender itself) can submit this signature on-chain to set the allowance. This eliminates the need for users to send a separate approve transaction, enabling gasless token approvals and single-transaction approve-and-swap flows.
designPurpose: ERC-2612 was designed to eliminate the two-transaction approval pattern that was a major UX friction point in DeFi. Previously, users had to first send an approve transaction (costing gas), wait for confirmation, and then send the actual swap or deposit transaction. With permit, users only need to sign a message (free and instant) and the approval can be bundled into the same transaction as the action, saving gas and improving the user experience.
commonUsage: ERC-2612 is widely used by DeFi protocols to enable gasless approvals and single-transaction flows. Uniswap, Aave, and many other protocols integrate permit to allow users to approve and swap in one transaction. It is also used by meta-transaction relayers and paymaster systems where a third party submits the permit on behalf of the user. Major tokens like DAI, USDC (v2), and UNI support ERC-2612.
fn.permit.desc: Sets the allowance for a spender using an off-chain EIP-712 signature from the token owner. Verifies the signature, checks the deadline, increments the nonce, and updates the allowance.
fn.permit.params.owner: The address of the token owner who signed the permit.
fn.permit.params.spender: The address being approved to spend the owner's tokens.
fn.permit.params.deadline: Unix timestamp after which the permit signature is no longer valid.
fn.permit.params.v: The v component of the ECDSA signature.
fn.permit.params.r: The r component of the ECDSA signature.
fn.permit.params.s: The s component of the ECDSA signature.
fn.nonces.desc: Returns the current nonce for an owner address. Each successful permit call increments the nonce, preventing signature replay.
fn.nonces.params.owner: The address to query the nonce for.
fn.nonces.returns.nonce: The current nonce value for the owner.
fn.DOMAIN_SEPARATOR.desc: Returns the EIP-712 domain separator used for encoding permit signatures. Includes the token name, version, chain ID, and contract address.
fn.DOMAIN_SEPARATOR.returns.separator: The bytes32 EIP-712 domain separator for this token contract.
sim.gaslessPermit.name: Gasless Permit Flow
sim.gaslessPermit.desc: Demonstrate a gasless token approval using an off-chain EIP-712 signature submitted by a relayer.
sim.gaslessPermit.step.sign: The token owner signs an EIP-712 typed data message off-chain containing the spender, value, nonce, and deadline. No gas is required.
sim.gaslessPermit.step.relay: The owner sends the signature (v, r, s) to a relayer or directly to the spender. The signature can be submitted by anyone.
sim.gaslessPermit.step.submit: The relayer submits the permit() transaction on-chain with the owner's signature, spender, value, and deadline parameters.
sim.gaslessPermit.step.ecrecover: The contract uses ecrecover with the EIP-712 hash and signature to recover the signer address and verify it matches the claimed owner.
sim.gaslessPermit.step.approve: The contract updates the allowance in storage, increments the owner's nonce to prevent replay, and emits an Approval event.
sim.gaslessPermit.step.use: The spender can now call transferFrom to use the approved allowance, completing the approve-and-spend in a seamless flow.
